channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.4).

item.title: [+1] US waives Russia-linked sanctions and tariffs that threatened 100% duties on India over Russian oil
item.description:
The order came two days before the law's measures took effect; it also covers China and three others. The waiver is temporary and existing Russia sanctions stay. Russia supplied about 45% of India's crude in August. Reverses an escalating threat.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Export tariff threat lifted

Why it matters: Removing the 100% tariff threat protects Indian exports to the US and lets refiners keep buying discounted Russian crude, easing the import bill and trade risk ahead of the US Secretary of State's visit.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Fiscal & trade balance +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India's exports to the US keep rising despite tariffs, while the China trade gap widens
item.description:
The tariff waiver may open the way for an India–US trade deal discussion during next week's visit. Ongoing.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — US demand holds

Why it matters: Resilient US demand supports Indian exporters, while a widening China deficit adds to dollar demand and import competition.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
